meta.name: consult
meta.description: AI consultation CLI — query Gemini, Codex, or Claude for reviews and analysis. ALWAYS check this skill before running any `consult` command. Use when reviewing specs, plans, implementations, or PRs with external models, running parallel 3-way reviews (cmap), or checking consultation stats. The `-m` model flag is always required except for `consult stats`.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能使用 `consult` 命令调用外部 AI 模型（Gemini、Codex、Claude）进行规格、计划、代码或 PR 的评审，并行三方评审，或查看统计数据。
howto.when: 当用户需要评审规格、计划、实现或 PR，或运行三方并行评审，或查看咨询统计时触发。
howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use the `consult` command to call external AI models (Gemini, Codex, Claude) for reviewing specs, plans, implementations, or PRs, running parallel 3-way reviews, or checking consultation stats.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user needs to review specs, plans, implementations, or PRs, run parallel 3-way reviews, or check consultation stats.

say_en.text: Have Codex and Claude review this PR in parallel.
